extract_wandb_metrics: extract metrics from all W&B runs in a project into a pandas DataFrame
extract_train_eval_data: extract both training and evaluation metrics from W&B runs into separate DataFrames
get_aggregated_metrics: get aggregated max eval and train metrics per model filtered by step horizon
run_wandb_results_retrieval: run the script to retrieve W&B results for a project and export to CSV
clean_wandb_model_name: clean a W&B run model name by removing trailing underscore-separated segments
